title: coord.py accepts --ttl nan or inf and --timeout nan, so a lease never expires and a wait never ends
goal: SP-rsmmwzr2 review G3 (ST-5iwikc3n, ST-qguxlob4): positive() and seconds() accept nan and inf (nan <= 0 is false); claim --ttl nan stores a NULL expiry and holds the key for ever (also over serve, by any operator), renew of it raises TypeError, the reply is invalid JSON (NaN), and wait --timeout nan never returns. Non-finite --ttl and --timeout exit 2.

run:
import json,os,socket,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T='_tools/coord.py'
D=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'))
def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
a=c('claim','K3','--ttl','nan','--holder','a')[0];b=c('claim','K4','--ttl','inf','--holder','a')[0]
try:
    w=c('wait','--since','0','--timeout','nan',t=5)[0]
except s.TimeoutExpired:
    w='hung'
print(dict(ttl_nan=a,ttl_inf=b,wait_nan=w));sys.exit(0 if a==2 and b==2 and w==2 else 1)
